label: Direct small-molecule binding to IDPs
short_description: Small molecules that bind transient pockets or shift the conformational ensemble of a disordered protein or region (e.g. AR N-terminal domain; MYC)
key_challenge: Weak/dynamic binding and hard-to-prove target engagement; first clinical attempt (masofaniten) failed

label: Condensate modulation
short_description: Drugs that dissolve; harden or reshape biomolecular condensates formed by IDR-driven phase separation
key_challenge: Mechanism-of-action ambiguity (condensate vs. client protein) and translation of in-vitro droplets to cells

label: Aggregation / oligomer inhibition
short_description: Block nucleation; oligomerisation or fibril growth of disordered proteins such as alpha-synuclein; tau; amyloid-beta
key_challenge: Neurodegeneration trials are long and costly; biomarkers of target engagement are limited

label: Peptides; mini-proteins & designed binders
short_description: Peptides; mini-proteins or de-novo designed protein binders that wrap around disordered segments
key_challenge: Intracellular delivery and developability of biologics

label: Molecular glues / complex stabilizers
short_description: Small molecules that stabilise complexes between a disordered motif and its folded partner (e.g. 14-3-3)

label: AI & physics ensemble modelling
short_description: Generative / ML models and simulations that predict conformational ensembles and binding for IDPs
key_challenge: Scarce ground-truth ensemble data; benchmarks mostly self-reported

label: Biophysics & measurement platforms
short_description: Experimental platforms (HDX-MS; NMR; microfluidics; smFRET; SAXS) used to characterise ensembles and condensates at scale
key_challenge: Throughput and cost of ensemble-level measurements
